title: One bounded read-only service-status retry after E009 mirror failure
objective: Obtain actual startup error of independent continuity service without changing established bridge/executor.
summary: Native systemctl status via existing capability-scoped executor, new task ID. This task changes no repository/runtime/service data. Previous E009 never reached operation because executor mirror fetch failed. Do not spin repeated retries if fetch remains unavailable.
why: Possible transient mirror-fetch failure must not be misdiagnosed as the standalone service fault.
first_incomplete_step: Successful executor source mirror refresh and attempted read-only service status.
next_action: If E010 reaches status and shows service error, fix standalone service only; if mirror fetch fails again, stop task retries and document upstream blocker.
